questions.prompt: What must Tailwind, the monolith, and Figma translation support?
questions.description: This choice separates component compatibility from a general source-code compiler.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Preserve public component contracts and Figma property vocabulary. Prove registry installation and Code Connect generation on Checkbox, then require later mappings to follow the same checked convention. Do not build a general Emotion-to-Tailwind or Tailwind-to-Emotion source converter.
